**PyRUA-Lean** (*Py*thon for lean *R*obot-*U*se *A*gents, the robot counterpart of computer-use agents) turns a robot into a Python object. A tool-calling agent spends a full LLM call on every small step of a task and re-sends everything before it each time. A PyRUA-Lean agent writes code against `robo` instead, so one call can find an object, move above it, grasp, check the gripper and try again.

## 🔥 News - [2026/10/30] 🔁 **PyRUA-RSI, offline version, open-sourced**: one fixed Python program per RoboDojo task, written ahead of time against the same `robo` API and run with no model call at evaluation time. On RoboDojo eval seed 0 (54 task configurations, 2,100 episodes) it reaches an **82.82%** average success rate (Score 87.16); on the held-out seed 2, 80.73% (85.36). [[Programs]](integrations/xpolicylab/PyRUA_RSI) [[Results]](integrations/xpolicylab/evaluation/robodojo_summary_rsi.md). manifest:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=77"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "pyrualean"
version = "0.2.0"
description = "A pyautogui-style robot library for code policies over RPent primitives"
readme = {file = "README.md", content-type = "text/markdown"}
requires-python = ">=3.10"
license = "Apache-2.0"
license-files = ["LICENSE", "NOTICE"]
authors = [{name = "PyRUA-Lean Contributors"}]
keywords = ["robotics", "code-as-policy", "libero", "agents"]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 3 - Alpha",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3 :: Only",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries",
]
dependencies = []

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "build>=1.2",
    "pytest>=8.0",
    "ruff>=0.8",
    "numpy",
    "pillow",
    # the in-process MCP server of `play` (RPent's environments already ship these);
    # it uses the lowlevel Server API of mcp 1.x, which mcp 2 removed
    "mcp>=1.8,<2",
    "uvicorn",
    "httpx",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/DAGroup-PKU/PyRUA-Lean"
Repository = "https://github.com/DAGroup-PKU/PyRUA-Lean"
Issues = "https://github.com/DAGroup-PKU/PyRUA-Lean/issues"

[project.scripts]
pyrualean = "pyrualean.cli:main"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
pyrualean = ["knowledge/*.md", "codex-catalog-gpt-6-astra-fallback.json"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
addopts = ["--import-mode=importlib"]
pythonpath = ["src"]
testpaths = ["tests"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
extend-exclude = ["runs"]
target-version = "py310"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "UP", "B"]
